relations.product: 600 MW battery storage facility under a long-term tolling agreement with GenCo, developed and constructed by an AGP Group affiliate
relations.quote: GenCo has contracted 600 MW of battery storage, under a long-term tolling agreement. The facility will be developed and constructed by an affiliate of AGP Group.
